verdict.rationale: BAMF is not itself an agent; it is a government information and service portal, and such a portal could plausibly publish an official MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, an API, or any agent connectivity. The evidence covers only migration, integration, asylum and statistics content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
